Kyun Jal Raha Hai Bait e Payamber Ko Kya Howa.
Koi Tu Aa Ke Pochta Iss Ghar Ko Kya Howa.

1
Yasrab Ki Rehne Waliyo Pocho Batool Se.
Hai Kyun Lahu Lahu Teri Chadar Ko Kya Howa.
Yeh Innama Ke Chehray Pe Kaisay Bana Hai Neel.
Roti Hai Kyun Rasool Ki Dukhtar Ko Kya Howa.

2
Anzalna Sar Ko Peet Rahi Hai Madine Mein.
Karta Hai Bain Sorah-e-Kausar Ko Kya Howa.
Haye Tamacha Haye Sitam Bolta Howa.
Sar Ko Jhukaye Rota Hai Shabbar Ko Kya Howa.

3
Kis Tarha Se Howa Hai Yeh Paiwast Gaal Mein.
Bibi Tumharey Kan Ke Gohar Ko Kya Howa.
 Saqlain Dekh Dekh Ke Chehray Yeh Jhuriyan.
Zainab Yeh Pochti Rahi Madar Ko Kya Howa.

git diff --check -- "$p" && python - "$p" <<'"'PY'
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

path = sys.argv[1]
before = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{path}'], text=True)
after = Path(path).read_text()
_, metadata, source = after.split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def normalize(lines):
    return [line.strip().rstrip('.').casefold() for line in lines.splitlines()]
assert normalize(roman.strip()) == normalize(before.split('---', 2)[2].strip())
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (source, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in blocks] == [2, 5, 5, 5]
    assert [block.splitlines()[0].strip() for block in blocks[1:]] == list(numbers)
print('Roman wording preserved and all 14 verses aligned.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and verified that the opening and three numbered stanzas align with `romanLyrics`. Preserved the Roman wording, normalizing capitalization and removing verse-end periods. Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read “Tu” in the opening as the emphatic تو and “Madar” in the final verse as مادر.
